description:
Read the complete linked Interslavic reader — Latin script · Download the PDF

This is the complete v047 Interslavic edition of the corpus defined by German authority NOETH-DE-ED-0011: Papers 1–43, Work 44, Paper 45, and the bibliography. The linked Latin-script reader is the easiest way to begin. The release also includes editable Latin- and Cyrillic-script sources and a deterministic Cyrillic reader in the supporting archive.

Citation and current status. Cite the frozen v047 release using its exact DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21926383. The stable concept DOI, 10.5281/zenodo.21926382, represents the Interslavic edition across releases. Verified post-v047 maintenance will appear together in the next complete rebuilt release; it is not part of, and does not alter, the frozen v047 release.

This is a machine-assisted scholarly working edition. It has not been peer-reviewed as a critical edition, and no native-speaker, community, or external certification is claimed.

Relations. This edition is a translation of German authority corpus NOETH-DE-ED-0011 and is part of the global multilingual Emmy Noether corpus. Its standalone source repository is KokunoYumeto/emmy-noether-isv.

Rights. CC0 applies only to the extent that rights exist in the project-created translation, typesetting, metadata, manifests, tools, and evidence. Emmy Noether’s original works, German editorial material, facsimiles, fonts, software, and other third-party material retain their own legal status and licenses.
title: Emmy Noether: Complete Interslavic Corpus Edition / Emmy Noether: Polno medžuslovjansko izdanje
